amendment_disclosure: The frozen registration package registered the case population, thresholds, endpoints, decision rules and classifier without binding a target system (no target had been designated at freeze time). This record binds the evaluated system and the execution condition BEFORE any execution: zero executions, zero outcomes, zero experimental scores and zero model calls exist at binding time; the only provider interaction is the public, credential-free catalog listing below. The frozen package is unchanged and remains authoritative; this record is additive and hash-sealed. Any later change would require a new recorded owner order.
binding_class: PRE-EXECUTION TARGET AND CONDITION BINDING (owner-authorized, data-blind, additive)

condition.prompt_authority: the frozen registration package case record is the sole prompt authority: the rendered presentation (premises + question + registered envelope) is the complete model input; no client prompt path exists
condition.provider_nondeterminism: disclosed: provider-side sampling nondeterminism may persist at temperature 0.0; recorded per execution; one-shot retry-NONE contract (M3 execution-contract semantics)

execution_contract.adjudication: downstream, post-campaign, mechanical: tools/rvr_adjudicate.py applies the frozen G-0 / R / M / I decision rules over the sealed outputs (thresholds read from the frozen package; never re-selected)
execution_contract.case_order: the frozen package registered case order (ordered_case_hash e4fe3ad8…), unmodified
execution_contract.credential: OPENROUTER_API_KEY resolved at launch through the authorized session credential gateway only; never in Git, never in records, never in evidence
execution_contract.ground_truth_flow: the private GT sidecar is verified against the public gt_commitment hashes at load; plaintext answers reach ONLY the in-process frozen classifier call site and are never persisted
execution_contract.one_campaign_per_evidence_root: the console refuses to start when a campaign ledger already exists under the evidence root (one-shot discipline)
execution_contract.retry_policy: NONE (a retry would violate the frozen execution contract)

execution_surface_identity.note: SHA-256 over the raw bytes of each file at binding time
